properties.displayName: [Baseline] Virtual machines should be protected by Azure Backup
properties.description: Audits virtual machines that are not protected by Azure Backup. A VM is compliant when a backup-protected item exists for it in a Recovery Services vault. Surfacing unprotected machines on the compliance dashboard is the first step of a backup rollout; pair with Microsoft's built-in DeployIfNotExists backup policies once a vault strategy is settled.

metadata.description: AuditIfNotExists reports VMs without backup protection; Disabled turns the policy off.
